capabilities: Show a floating toolbar near the current selection
Apply bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, and highlights
Apply named or custom HEX text and background colors
Insert internal links with a note and alias picker
Pin, reorder, and configure toolbar actions per vault
disambiguation: Not a general formatting or Markdown-rewriting plugin; it only formats the current text selection from a popup toolbar.
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later and Live Preview or Source mode. Not yet listed in the community directory, so installation is manual from GitHub Releases. Custom colors are written as inline HTML spans that remain in notes after disabling the plugin and may be stripped by export tools. Version 0.1.5 upgrades plugin data to schema 3, which older plugin versions reject.
problem: Applying frequent small formatting edits in Obsidian requires moving to the ribbon, command palette, or typing Markdown by hand, away from the text being edited.
summary: Floating selection toolbar for desktop Obsidian that applies bold, italic, highlight, inline code, text and background colors, and internal links to selected text.
